name: lab-persistence-and-tooling
description: Persistence, defence impairment and YARA checks for dc01. Adapted from palantir/osquery-configuration (commit 89c2ae5, 2020) and the official osquery windows-attacks pack.

startup_items.query: SELECT name, path, args, source, status, username FROM startup_items;

runonceex_registry.query: SELECT key, path, name, data FROM registry WHERE key LIKE 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnceEx%%';

winlogon_helpers.query: SELECT path, name, data FROM registry WHERE key = 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon' AND name IN ('Shell', 'Userinit', 'Notify');

ifeo_debugger.query: SELECT key, name, data FROM registry WHERE key LIKE 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\%' AND name IN ('Debugger', 'GlobalFlag');

services.query: SELECT name, display_name, start_type, path, module_path, user_account FROM services;

scheduled_tasks.query: SELECT name, path, action, enabled, hidden FROM scheduled_tasks;

wmi_cli_consumers.query: SELECT name, command_line_template, executable_path FROM wmi_cli_event_consumers;

wmi_script_consumers.query: SELECT name, scripting_engine, script_file_name, script_text FROM wmi_script_event_consumers;

dns_server_plugin_dll.query: SELECT key, name, data FROM registry WHERE key = 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\services\DNS\Parameters' AND name = 'ServerLevelPluginDll';

amsi_disabled.query: SELECT r.path, r.data, u.username FROM registry r, users u WHERE r.path = 'HKEY_USERS\' || u.uuid || '\Software\Microsoft\Windows Script\Settings\AmsiEnable' AND r.data = '0';

telemetry_settings.query: SELECT path, data FROM registry WHERE path IN ('HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\Audit\ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled', 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\ScriptBlockLogging\EnableScriptBlockLogging', 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\ModuleLogging\EnableModuleLogging', 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell\Transcription\EnableTranscripting');

security_tooling_services.query: SELECT name, status, start_type FROM services WHERE name IN ('Sysmon64', 'Elastic Agent', 'ElasticEndpoint', 'WinDefend', 'EventLog');

yara_user_writable.query: SELECT path, matches, count, strings, tags FROM yara WHERE (path LIKE 'C:\Users\%%' OR path LIKE 'C:\Windows\Temp\%%' OR path LIKE 'C:\PerfLogs\%%') AND sigfile = 'C:\ProgramData\yara\yara-forge-core.yar' AND count > 0;
